_about: ReaPersona. Each style: a shortcut layer (Main alt-N) + a theme + 'feel' (settings and mouse behaviours, put back when you switch away) + MIDI editor keys. Keys not listed fall through to your own shortcuts. Every key is the DAW's default from its maker's documentation (docs). keys: [key, REAPER command id | named id | 'MAIN:<key>' (whatever your Main section runs there) | 'script:<DAW Styles action>', what the DAW calls it]. midi_keys: [key, REAPER MIDI editor action name (or a list run in order), what the DAW calls it, times to run]. feel: ['toggle', command, wanted state, what] or ['mouse', context, modifier flag (1 Shift, 2 Ctrl, 4 Alt), REAPER behaviour, what]. Change keys here, then run install_shortcuts.py with REAPER closed. feel also takes ['dock', window, side, shown, what]; recommends lists extensions (core.EXTENSIONS); kind 'theme' puts a style on the Themes page.

Alt+R

styles.name: Pro Tools
styles.description: Avid Pro Tools (Windows keys). Space starts and stops and goes back to where you started, Ctrl+Space records, Enter returns to the start, Ctrl+E separates, Ctrl+H heals, Ctrl+= swaps Edit and Mix, R/T zoom (Commands Keyboard Focus). Smart Tool: the top half of a clip moves it, the bottom half selects. Playlists are REAPER's fixed lanes, with Pro Tools' comping keys. Memory locations: period, number, Enter on the keypad.

Solo the Playlist lane containing the Edit cursor (here: the lane under the mouse)
Cycle in material in the Edit selection from the previous playlist (here: move the comp area up a lane)
Cycle in material in the Edit selection from the next playlist (here: move the comp area down a lane)

Workspace browser is its own window (here: the Media Explorer, floating)

Ripple off (Slip mode; F1 is Shuffle)
Smart Tool: dragging the bottom half of a clip selects a range (Selector); the top half moves it (Grabber)
Selector: dragging in an empty part of a track selects a range
extras: Edit modes: Shuffle is REAPER's ripple editing per track (F1), Slip is ripple off (F2), Grid is snap (F4). Spot has no equivalent.
F1
Smart Tool: on (the bottom half of a clip selects, the top half moves it). Change it in Preferences > Mouse modifiers > Media item bottom half.
Tab to Transient moves to the next transient in the selected items.
Tab
Playlists: turn on fixed lanes for a track; each take is a lane. Shift+S solos the lane under the mouse, Ctrl+Shift+Up/Down cycles the comp area through lanes.
Memory Locations: REAPER's markers. Keypad period, number, Enter recalls one; the Region/Marker Manager lists them.
Num.
Pro Tools track colours: in SWS Color Management, Load the palette PT2020.SWSColor (or PT125) from ColorThemes, then colour tracks from it.
_SWSCOLORWND
Clip gain: drag an item's top edge (its volume handle), or show a take volume envelope to draw it.

Drag in empty space to rubber-band select, Option-drag copies.
